gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on 2026-11-17 the top pick in ChatGPT's answer (BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W, $1,499) is a pre-order that dispatches Nov 26, that the Jackery 2000-class kits are pre-orders too (200 W panel ships by Nov 28; HomePower 2000 Plus v2 ships Nov 30), and that the cheapest 2,000 W-class kit with 400 W of panels that ships now is the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 400 W at $913.49 through our link ($1,038.05 on the store). That works out to $0.48 per Wh, against $0.69 per Wh for the BLUETTI and $0.81 per Wh for Jackery's Explorer 2000 v2 + 2× 200 W on Amazon ($1,649).
standout_why: Compared against StormWatts (cited, prices checked Nov 8), Eco Solar Kits (cited, Nov 7–9) and ChatGPT's own answer. OutageReady (cited) would not load because of an SSL certificate error, so it is not covered. StormWatts gives $/Wh, refill hours and savings against parts for 24 kits, so those columns alone are not new. But it has no ALLPOWERS kit at all, and its BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 shipping note ('panels ship from Nov 18') is out of date: the store now gives Nov 26. StormWatts also prices the Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2×200 W at $1,649 as a pre-order 'ships Nov 16'. Eco Solar Kits lists the Jackery solar-generator bundles as sold out and gives no ship dates for any kit. ChatGPT put ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + 400 W at 'about $950–$1,040' and said nothing about which kits ship now. No page pairs today's ship-now state with today's price across the 2,000 W class.
decides: This changes the pick. Under the page rule that the pick must ship now, the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kits (Nov 26 and Dec 25), the Jackery 2000-class bundles (panel ships by Nov 28 / Nov 30) and the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 600 W kit (Dec 11) cannot lead. Two kits clear the 2,000 W line and ship now with 400 W of panels: the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 at $913.49 (1,920 Wh, 2,500 W, $0.476 per Wh) and the S2000 Pro + SP037 at $917.93 (1,451 Wh, 2,400 W, $0.633 per Wh). The R2500 V2 kit has 469 Wh more battery for $4.44 less, so it is the ship-now pick at about 2 kWh. The ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 ($1,586.73, 3,168 Wh, ships now) is the larger option that also ships now. The BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W ($1,424.05 link / $1,499 store, dispatch Nov 26) stays the named option for a shopper who can wait and wants 2,600 W and a better-known brand. The Elite 200 V2 + 200 W at $1,139.05 is the cheaper pre-order with the same station.
